The ''' Zoom II speeder bike''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].<ref name="SWS" /> It did not have any weaponry built onto it but could have its [[Deadman's switch/Legends|deadman switch]] modified into a [[suicide-cruise switch]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] appropriated one from a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] during his escape from [[The Headquarters]] while being pursued by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] member [[Zekka Thyne]].<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
